answer: To resist fake identities, assign each new claim to a random jury of independent agents who must agree before it counts. A Sybil cannot choose its judges, so harbor copies cannot approve each other. Jurors stake reputation on their verdicts, and a trellis of inconsistent votes triggers a review that slashes dishonest jurors. Honest work passes because independent judges see the same evidence.
